en.headline: Man arrested over FEHD Mark Six dispute released on bail
en.dek: Police said the 36-year-old detained on suspicion of theft after a prize-sharing row among colleagues must report back in mid-October.
body: A 36-year-old man arrested on Friday on suspicion of theft after a dispute over a Mark Six prize among Food and Environmental Hygiene Department staff has been released on bail, pending further inquiries, RTHK reported on Saturday morning.

Police said they received a report on Wednesday from a man who said he and several colleagues had pooled money to buy tickets for last Saturday’s draw, with one male colleague handling the purchase. After the tickets won, the complainant and that colleague could not agree on how to share a prize of about HK$30 million.

According to reporting by RTHK and other local outlets, the arrested man works for the department and was the colleague who placed the bets. Colleagues alleged he declined to split the winnings and later lost contact, prompting the police report. He is required to report back to police in mid-October.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it was aware of the police investigation and would cooperate as required, adding that it would not comment on details at this stage. The man has not been convicted of any offence.

zh.headline: 食環職員六合彩糾紛案男子獲准保釋
zh.dek: 警方表示，周五因涉嫌盜竊被捕的36歲男子已獲准保釋候查，須於10月中旬向警方報到。
body: 港台周六上午報道，一名36歲男子周五因與同事就六合彩彩金分配未能達成共識、其後失去聯絡，被警方以涉嫌盜竊拘捕，現已獲准保釋候查，須於10月中旬向警方報到。
警方表示，星期三接獲一名男子報案，指上星期六與數名同事夾份買彩票，由其中一名男同事負責購買，中獎後雙方就彩金事宜未能達成共識，涉款約3,000萬元。
綜合港台及其他本地傳媒報道，被捕男子為食物環境衞生署職員，負責落注。同事指他拒絕平分彩金後失聯，因而報案。案件仍在調查，該名男子尚未被定罪。
食環署表示，知悉警方正展開調查，會按需要配合，現階段不宜評論細節。
